## History

Skinner was previously married to a man named Crowe before marrying her husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md). She met [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at the [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and gave her a ride to her boarding house, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the drive, she garrulously shared stories about her courtship with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), her choice to marry for love rather than money, and the unhappy marriage of her cousin, [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane-ann--skinner.md)

[Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) is the cousin of Skinner's wife, Amelia Skinner. During a carriage ride with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Amelia mentions [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) while recounting stories of her own family and courtship, noting that [Jane Ann](../character/jane-ann.md) suffered an unhappy marriage.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), +1 more_
